info.title: probectl control-plane API
info.description: Operational endpoints plus the versioned /v1 resource API. Protected /v1 routes resolve the tenant from the authenticated session/OIDC principal, then enforce the tenant boundary before RBAC/ABAC. The X-Probectl-Tenant header is a local dev-auth/test override only; release binaries do not accept it as an identity source.

get.summary: Secret-backend health (S41)
get.description: Per-backend operational health of the S41 secrets resolver: configured schemes (env/vault/cyberark/aws/azure/gcp), resolve/failure counters, live (unexpired) lease counts, last success time, and the last REDACTED error. Never contains secret material or reference fragments. resolver_running=false distinguishes an unwired resolver from a healthy-but-idle one. Requires directory read (admin surface).

get.summary: Editions / license state (S-T0)
get.description: The deployment's edition truth: tier (core/enterprise/msp), informational pricing model (flat/consumption), lifecycle state (community, active, grace, read_only), customer + expiry + read-only horizon when licensed, the MSP tenant band and meter vocabulary, and the full gated-feature table with per-feature licensed/mode status. This endpoint is the ONE place tiers appear when unlicensed (the hidden-unlicensed UX): commercial features are otherwise invisible without an entitlement. License verification is offline (Ed25519 against build-time-baked keys) — never phone-home; expiry degrades read-only after a 30-day grace and never breaks running telemetry.

pricing_model.description: Informational commercial model; feature enforcement comes only from tier.

meters.description: Canonical local usage meters, present for MSP licenses only.

display_name.description: Human-facing feature label. Stable license keys remain in name.

get.summary: Topology dependency graph (S43)
get.description: The caller's tenant's dependency graph (agents, hops, hosts, services, prefixes, ASes, devices) in a layout-agnostic node/edge shape, live or AS IT WAS at ?at= (the versioned-graph contract). Includes the per-plane coverage block (path/flow/routing/device edge counts + honesty notes) so the operator can see what the graph actually contains. topology_running=false distinguishes an unwired store.

x-probectl-pagination.reason: Topology graph is held in a bounded per-tenant graph store and served as a snapshot.

post.summary: What-if / impact simulation (S43)
post.description: Simulates the failure of one node (e.g. hop:10.0.0.1, service:api, as:64500) or edge (from|kind|to) at a point in time and returns the predicted impact: broken vs rerouted agent→target paths (with the surviving route), affected path tests identified by agent+target, transitively impacted services, impacted prefixes, newly disconnected nodes, and SLO impact when the S45 engine is wired. READ-ONLY: the simulation runs on a copy; probectl never acts on or prevents failures from predictions (S-EE5 is human-gated). Confidence is a coverage score, not a probability. The coverage block reports completeness honestly. Unknown targets are a 404, never an empty 'no impact'.

target.description: Node id or edge id (from|kind|to) to fail.

parameters.description: Node id or edge id (from|kind|to) to fail.

get.summary: List the tenant's owned-vantage coverage matrix
get.description: Returns a read-only matrix derived only from authenticated agent placement labels, enabled test definitions, and the caller tenant's bounded latest-result partition. Region and site are operator declarations; the server performs no IP geolocation or network lookup. No evidence is uncovered, old evidence is stale, and one independent vantage is non_redundant. The endpoint never enrolls an agent or creates a test.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum agent-test candidate rows considered before aggregation.

403.description: The principal lacks test.read or agent.read.

x-probectl-pagination.reason: The storage query caps the tenant-constrained agent-test candidate product and reports truncation explicitly.

get.summary: FinOps egress-cost summary (S44)
get.description: The caller's tenant's network-cost picture: egress volume x public pricing attributed per service and per team (showback), traffic-class breakdown (same-zone / inter-AZ / inter-region / internet), cross-AZ 'chatty' zone-pair conversations, hourly trend, and budget status. Honesty flags: cost_running=false (engine unwired), priced=false (volume-only — no price table), zones_mapped=false (no CIDR→zone rules). Pricing provenance (source + as-of date) is surfaced; rates are PUBLIC list ballparks the operator overrides — this is attribution, not billing reconciliation.

get.summary: Network energy/carbon estimate (S48)
get.description: The caller's tenant's ESTIMATED network transmission energy and carbon: flow volume × published energy-per-byte coefficients × the operator-set grid intensity, attributed to services/teams through the same mapping as the FinOps engine. The methodology block (measured=false, coefficient source, grid intensity, the estimate note) rides every response — these are coefficient-based estimates for relative attribution and trends, not measured device power. carbon_running=false distinguishes an unwired engine.

get.summary: SLO statuses (S45)
get.description: The caller's tenant's SLO statuses from the OpenSLO-defined SLIs: attainment over the SLO window, error budget remaining, total events, cold_start honesty flag, and the multi-window burn rates (fast 1h/5m @14.4x, medium 6h/30m @6x, slow 3d/6h @1x — the Google SRE multi-window multi-burn-rate method) with per-window firing state. slo_running=false distinguishes an unwired engine.

x-probectl-pagination.reason: SLO status is bounded by the loaded OpenSLO definitions, not telemetry event cardinality.

get.summary: OpenSLO export (S45)
get.description: The loaded SLO definitions as an OpenSLO v1 YAML stream (multi-document). Lossless: documents round-trip unchanged between probectl and other OpenSLO tooling. Definitions are deployment-level configuration (PROBECTL_SLO_DIR); statuses are tenant-scoped.

get.summary: Collective internet-outage view (S47a)
get.description: The collective internet-outage view for the caller's tenant: shared public outage events (IODA / Cloudflare Radar — opt-in feeds, ingested once) annotated with THIS tenant's affected tests, the tenant's own vantage-detected outages, per-feed health + AUP provenance, and coverage notes. Honesty contract: coverage = your vantage points + public open data — probectl does not operate a global probe fleet; scope_resolution=false reports that IP enrichment is off and correlation is degraded; outage_running=false distinguishes an unwired engine.

x-probectl-pagination.reason: Outage view is bounded by per-tenant target/history/correlation caps and feed retention.

get.summary: RUM convergence view (S47b)
get.description: The caller's tenant's real-user-monitoring convergence view: per (app, host) window aggregates (views, error rate, p75 LCP/TTFB, per-page-group stats) joined with synthetic coverage into a verdict — healthy, user_impact_confirmed (both planes degraded), synthetic_only_no_user_impact, or user_only_synthetic_blind (the coverage blind spot). The privacy block reports the enforced posture (consent required, URL redaction, no IP storage) and per-reason rejection counters. Claims cover what probectl OBSERVED; absence of RUM data is not proof of health. rum_running=false distinguishes an unwired engine.

x-probectl-pagination.reason: RUM summary is bounded by per-tenant app/page/host aggregates, not raw beacon history.

post.summary: RUM beacon ingest (S47b) — public-key routed
post.description: The browser-beacon ingest. NOT session-authenticated: each beacon carries a public app key in the body (sendBeacon cannot set headers); the key routes to the configured tenant/app and rate-limit bucket, but it is not authentication and never grants read access. The server binds to the KEY's configured tenant, never the payload's. Multi-tenant and regulated deployments require configured origins, and any configured origin allow-list rejects off-list or missing Origins before publish. The privacy contract is enforced here, fail-closed: consent must be explicitly true; unknown fields reject the beacon (identifier-bearing payloads can never ingest); URLs are redacted server-side (query/fragment stripped, volatile segments collapsed); the client IP and user agent are never stored. Per-key rate limiting (429 + Retry-After), optional beacon-id dedupe (accepted duplicates are not republished), and a 16KiB size cap (413) bound the surface. CORS: wildcard only when no origin allow-list is configured; allow-listed apps echo only matching Origins; write-only, credential-less; OPTIONS serves the preflight.

key.description: app key → (tenant, app); an identifier, not a secret; never stored

id.description: random page-view id used for short-lived replay/dedupe; not stored in the canonical result

host.description: bare page host — the synthetic↔RUM join key

202.description: Beacon accepted. duplicate=true means a replayed beacon id was accepted but not republished.

get.summary: Segmentation validation results (S46)
get.description: The caller's tenant's per-rule segmentation verdicts from OBSERVED flow/eBPF traffic: violation (forbidden traffic observed, with bounded flow evidence), observed_clean (traffic between the zones observed, none in the forbidden scope), or not_observed (no traffic seen — explicitly NOT proof of isolation). The coverage block states what was actually watched; probectl never claims 'compliant' beyond observed traffic, and never enforces.

x-probectl-pagination.reason: Compliance summary is bounded by configured rules and capped violation samples.

get.summary: Audit-grade compliance evidence export (S46)
get.description: A self-verifying, timestamped evidence document: per-rule results with PCI DSS / NIST / zero-trust framework mappings and bounded violation samples, hash-chained via the internal crypto provider (any post-export tampering breaks verification), with the coverage caveats embedded — an auditor sees exactly what was and wasn't observed. Requires audit read.

get.description: Every series the caller's tenant's alert evaluator currently has firing, with operator state (silenced_until, acked_by/at). evaluator_running=false distinguishes a quiet tenant from one with no running evaluator.

x-probectl-pagination.reason: Active-alert view is the bounded in-memory current-state set, not an event history.

get.summary: Durable alert-to-postmortem workflow receipts
get.description: Joins the caller tenant's current evaluator truth to immutable acknowledge/silence audit receipts and, when incident_id is supplied and freshly authorized through tenant RLS, the linked incident plus persisted on-call/ticket delivery receipts. An unavailable fingerprint or cross-tenant incident id fails closed.

parameters.name: incident_id
parameters.description: Optional incident id from the tenant-scoped incident list; the server re-authorizes it through RLS before returning any incident or connector receipt.

200.description: Current alert state, durable operator receipts, linked incident, and connector delivery receipts.

404.description: No current or durable workflow exists for the fingerprint, or the incident is outside the caller tenant.

post.summary: Silence a firing alert's notifications until a deadline
post.description: Suppresses channel notifications (and the incident sink) for one firing series for duration_minutes (0 clears, max 7 days). The series keeps evaluating and stays listed as firing; the silence clears automatically on resolve or expiry. The reason and deadline are persisted with an immutable audit receipt.

404.description: No firing alert with that fingerprint.

503.description: The alert evaluator is not running for this tenant.

post.summary: Acknowledge a firing alert (records who owns it)
post.description: Records the caller as having seen/owning the firing series. Evaluation and delivery are unchanged; the ack clears on resolve. The operator reason is persisted with an immutable audit receipt.

404.description: No firing alert with that fingerprint.

503.description: The alert evaluator is not running for this tenant.

get.summary: List reusable planned-maintenance windows
get.description: The caller tenant's alert evaluator schedule. Windows suppress matching firing notifications during planned work; evaluator_running=false distinguishes an empty schedule from a tenant with no running evaluator.

x-probectl-pagination.reason: Maintenance windows are the bounded in-memory evaluator schedule, not an alert-history stream.

post.summary: Create or update a planned-maintenance window
post.description: Installs a tenant-scoped reusable suppression window. It can target rule_ids, resource labels in match, or both; daily and weekly recurrence are supported. Writes emit alert.maintenance_upsert audit events.

200.description: The created or updated maintenance window.

503.description: The alert evaluator is not running for this tenant.

post.summary: Preview planned-maintenance occurrences
post.description: Previews saved windows, or an unsaved window supplied in the request, against a rule_id and resource labels over a bounded time range. The preview range must be <= 90 days and does not mutate evaluator state.

503.description: The alert evaluator is not running for this tenant.

delete.description: Deletes one tenant-scoped reusable maintenance window and emits an alert.maintenance_delete audit event.

404.description: No maintenance window with that id.

503.description: The alert evaluator is not running for this tenant.

get.summary: TLS/certificate posture inventory (latest analyzed posture per target)
get.description: The caller's tenant's certificate inventory from the S27 posture pipeline: per-target leaf certificate, protocol/cipher, weakness/CT/threat-intel findings, severity, and the verbatim trustctl handoff payload. collector_running=false distinguishes an unwired collector from an empty fleet.

x-probectl-pagination.reason: TLS posture inventory uses a bounded per-tenant posture store.

get.summary: Get SIEM export status
get.description: Read-only posture for the operator-configured SIEM export. The response reports whether export is enabled and configured, which preset/format are active, durable no-drop delivery posture, and sanitized endpoint metadata. It never returns the ingest token or full endpoint path/query.

get.summary: Recent IOC/NDR detections with source attribution + confidence
get.description: The caller's tenant's recent threat detections (newest first), projected from the durable incident signal timeline in HA deployments: the flagged entity, the matched indicator, the attributing feed/detector with confidence and license, and the correlated incident id (the triage pivot). Detections are confidence-scored SIGNALS — probectl never blocks — and feeds can list benign infrastructure, so provenance ships verbatim. detections_running=false distinguishes unwired DB-less consumers from a quiet tenant.

confidence.description: Threat confidence in percentage points; omitted when unavailable.

x-probectl-pagination.reason: Threat detections are bounded by the durable/read-model detection cap and never represent full packet history.

get.summary: Open-data and threat-intel AUP plus refresh health matrix
get.description: Tenant-authenticated, threat.read-gated operator status for shared open-data and threat-intel sources. It enumerates configured open-data sources and built-in threat-intel feed descriptors with AUP/provenance, enabled state, last-good refresh health, last error, and retained IOC counts. The response is shared-source metadata only: no tenant telemetry, detections, flows, or documents are returned.

get.summary: Endpoint DEM fleet: WiFi/gateway/last-mile health + slowdown attribution
get.description: The caller's tenant's endpoint fleet (S37 DEM): per-endpoint latest WiFi link, gateway/local-network, last-mile segments, browser sessions, and the attribution verdict (wifi/local/isp/network/none) with confidence — impaired endpoints first. Privacy-minimized fields the agent withheld are absent, never re-derived. The bounded latest-view cache is hydrated from tenant-partitioned durable endpoint events after a control-plane restart; the query never loads another tenant. collector_running=false distinguishes an unwired consumer from an empty fleet.

x-probectl-pagination.reason: Endpoint DEM view is a bounded latest-state snapshot per tenant/agent.

get.summary: List per-user saved inventory views
get.description: Lists the caller's saved list/filter views inside the current tenant. A saved view stores filter choices only; opening one always re-queries the current tenant-scoped inventory.

x-probectl-pagination.reason: Saved views are bounded operator preferences, not inventory rows.

post.summary: Create a per-user saved inventory view
post.description: Persists a saved filter set for the authenticated user in the caller tenant. The tenant_id and owner_id are never accepted from the browser; they are resolved from the authenticated session before storage.

get.summary: Open a per-user saved inventory view
get.description: Returns one saved view only when it belongs to the authenticated user inside the caller tenant. Cross-tenant or cross-user IDs return 404.

get.summary: Latest synthetic result per (type, target, agent) with full detail
get.description: The caller's tenant's newest result per synthetic series, carrying the full per-type detail (DNS rcode/answers/DNSSEC, HTTP dns/connect/tls/ttfb waterfall phases, browser transaction step timings, ICMP/TCP/UDP latency families + loss) — the read model behind the test-result views (S-FE5). collector_running=false distinguishes an unwired consumer from no results yet.

x-probectl-pagination.reason: Latest results retain one newest result per tenant/type/target/agent with a per-tenant cap.

get.summary: Recent synthetic results inside a trailing window, oldest first
get.description: The caller's tenant's recent synthetic results observed inside the trailing window (default 1h), oldest first and plot-ready, from the same bounded in-memory read model as /v1/results/latest — the series behind real-time-axis latency/duration trends (S11). collector_running=false distinguishes an unwired consumer from a quiet window.

parameters.name: window
parameters.description: Trailing observation window as a Go duration (for example 15m, 1h); the server defaults to 1h when absent.

x-probectl-pagination.reason: History serves a bounded per-tenant ring of recent observations (evict-oldest); long-horizon series live in the TSDB.

TenantHeader.name: X-Probectl-Tenant
TenantHeader.description: Local dev-auth/test tenant override. In release/session mode the tenant is resolved from the authenticated principal, and this header is not an identity credential.

shared.description: Shares only within the same tenant; RBAC still applies.

download_url.description: Same-origin authenticated path; never an external URL.

token_overrides.description: Deployment-wide allowlisted CSS design-token values. Absent means the shipped dark/aurora themes are unmodified.

audit_retention.description: Aggregate audit-retention posture. Carries no tenant data or audit payloads; reports whether raw in-DB audit rows can age out behind WORM/SIEM export watermarks.

ErrorCode.description: Stable machine-readable API error codes. Clients branch on this enum; message is human-facing and may be localized.

ErrorDetail.description: The inner API error object. Code is stable and machine-readable; message is human-facing; request_id joins client output to server logs.

Error.description: The standard error envelope returned by every endpoint.

TestRequest.description: The mutable fields of a synthetic test.

target.description: Required for all types except noop. For browser tests this is the start URL unless params.script supplies start_url.

params.description: Per-type string parameters. For browser tests, params.script may carry browser.Script JSON; when omitted, the agent runs a default transaction that opens target and expects HTTP 200.

next_cursor.description: Cursor for the next page; absent when the last page was returned (SCALE-002).

labels.description: Bounded operator-supplied local metadata reported on the authenticated agent channel. region and site drive the owned-vantage coverage matrix; no geolocation lookup is performed.

FleetSafeAction.description: Exactly one read-only, authorized next step. The action opens tenant-scoped evidence or the human-gated rollout runbook; it never updates an agent.

allOf.description: Tenant-scoped fleet action-center view. Health and rollout fields are derived from authenticated registry heartbeats, the N/N-1 lifecycle policy, reported capabilities, and persisted staged-rollout plans.

last_failure.description: Most relevant known rollout, heartbeat, capability, or unsupported-version failure; empty when none is recorded.

next_cursor.description: Cursor for the next page; absent when the last page was returned (SCALE-010).

control_version.description: Control-plane version used to derive N/N-1 agent version health.

rollouts_available.description: Whether persisted staged-rollout evidence was available while building this page.

state.description: ready means operational/data observed, quiet means running without tenant data, and blocked means unavailable or unhealthy.

next_action.description: Tenant-relative UI route for the next useful action.

agent_enroll_token_created.description: True once this tenant has minted at least one agent enrollment token. The token value remains show-once only.

agent_registered.description: True once at least one agent row exists for this tenant.

agent_connected.description: True once a tenant-bound producer has completed an authenticated registration or heartbeat.

producer_healthy.description: True while at least one tenant-bound producer has a current online heartbeat.

first_test_created.description: True once at least one synthetic test exists for this tenant.

first_result_received.description: True once the server has retained a real result in this tenant's result partition.

first_finding_visible.description: True once a named, navigable finding receipt is available.

scim_token_created.description: True once at least one SCIM provisioning token row exists for this tenant.

readiness_steps_complete.description: Count of operational milestones only: connected, healthy, result, finding. Setup artifacts do not advance it.

HopGeo.description: Approximate responder location, sourced exclusively from operator-supplied data (PROBECTL_HOP_GEO_FILE); no external geolocation service is ever contacted.

HopNode.description: One responder at a TTL; multiple nodes at a TTL are ECMP branches.

PathSnapshot.description: One immutable path-discovery round. The opaque ID is always read under tenant_id and target scope.

secret.description: Webhook HMAC secret; redacted (***) in responses.

owner_id.description: Authenticated user that owns this preset inside the tenant.

Signal.description: One plane's observation on an incident timeline (extensible: plane/kind are free-form, attributes is arbitrary).

signal_count.description: Total durable signal count, including evidence omitted by the bounded detail response.

signals_truncated.description: True when the incident has more evidence than this response returns; omitted evidence is a coverage gap, never a healthy zero.

signals_limit.description: Maximum number of time-ordered signals returned when signals_truncated is true.

Me.description: The authenticated caller: the resolved tenant (always present), identity, and the effective RBAC permission keys within that tenant.

tenant_name.description: Tenant display name read under the authenticated tenant's RLS scope.

tenant_slug.description: Tenant slug read under the authenticated tenant's RLS scope.

time_zone.description: The caller's preferred IANA timezone. Defaults to UTC when no user preference is known.

locale.description: The caller's preferred BCP 47 locale tag. Defaults to en when no user preference is known.

tenant_time_zone.description: The tenant default IANA timezone. User preference wins when both are present.

tenant_locale.description: The tenant default BCP 47 locale tag. User preference wins when both are present.

AuditEvent.description: One record in the tenant's hash-chained, tamper-evident audit log. Privacy erasure is a projection: actor/target/data can be returned as erased tokens, while prev_hash/hash remain the raw-chain proof.

actor.description: Who performed the action (email, user id, or an erased-subject projection token).

target.description: The id of the affected resource.

data.description: Structured event data after audit privacy projection. If subject erasure applied, matching values are replaced with an erased token and _probectl_privacy describes the projection.

OncallStatus.description: Read-only, tenant-scoped on-call/ITSM posture. Secrets and endpoint path/query values are intentionally omitted.

id.description: Opaque connector id for test delivery; unique only within the caller tenant's status response.

tenant_routed.description: True when the connector is registered only for the caller tenant.

endpoint_host.description: Host:port metadata only; URL path, query, and credentials are never returned.

SIEMStatus.description: Read-only SIEM export posture. Endpoint path/query and ingest token are intentionally omitted.

format.description: Resolved format when valid; raw configured value when reason=invalid_format.

endpoint_host.description: Only scheme-free host:port metadata; path, query, and credentials are never returned.

next.description: Cursor to pass as ?after= for the next page (0 when no more).

detail.description: Present when ok=false: where and how the chain is broken.

question.description: Natural-language question, e.g. "why is api.example.com slow?"

subject.description: Optional explicit subject pins (target, prefix, node, incident_id). Tenant and evidence scope are rejected because they come only from authentication and authorized queries.

filters.description: Bounded source fields only. tenant, tenant_id, and semantic variants are rejected.

comparison_sources.description: Sources whose tenant-scoped dispatch honors both explicit historical windows. Current-state-only sources are omitted.

ExplorerComparisonRequest.description: The query carries the current absolute window. The previous window is explicit and independently validated. Tenant scope is never accepted in the body.

AIQueryRange.description: The current investigation time window. Both bounds are server-validated; start must not be after end.

fields.description: Allow-listed source fields used to resolve a citation back to its authorized source object.

adapter.description: Server-reported adapter that produced the rendered answer.

attempted_adapter.description: Present only when the built-in synthesizer answered after a configured adapter failed.

AIReasoningProvenance.description: Server-authored sovereignty state. Clients must not infer locality from model names or configuration text.

prompt.description: e.g. "check Salesforce login from every branch"

params.description: Per-type string parameters. For browser tests, params.script may carry browser.Script JSON.

ChangeEvent.description: A normalized change event ingested from a signed webhook (S29).

BGPEvent.description: A tenant-scoped BGP/routing signal projected from the incident timeline.

DeviceInventory.description: One managed network device visible in the tenant topology graph.

DeviceMetricSummary.description: Latest retained sample for one device/metric/interface series.

content.description: Raw submitted config; stored and returned after common secret redaction.

EBPFServiceEdge.description: One tenant-scoped eBPF host/L7 service edge aggregate.

ChangeCandidate.description: A change scored as a candidate cause of an incident.

ABACPolicy.description: An ABAC policy evaluated after RBAC (deny-override).

TenantIdPSettings.description: Public metadata for the caller tenant's OIDC provider. Secret material is represented only by client_secret_configured.

issuer.description: HTTPS issuer URL, or an empty string when no IdP is configured.

redirect_url.description: HTTPS callback URL, or an empty string when no IdP is configured.

TenantIdPSettingsInput.description: Tenant OIDC override. client_secret is write-only; omit it to preserve an existing encrypted secret.

SCIMToken.description: A SCIM bearer-token metadata row. The token hash and plaintext token are never returned from list/get responses.

SCIMTokenCreated.description: The one-time SCIM bearer token response. The token value is never retrievable again.

FlowTopRow.description: One top-talkers row. key is the address/ASN per the grouping; detail carries the pair destination or AS organization name.

series.description: Bucketed history for at most the first six ranked contributors.

flow_retention_days.description: Per-tenant flow retention in days; null uses the deployment default.

otel_retention_days.description: Per-tenant OTLP trace/log retention in days; null uses the deployment default.

ebpf_retention_days.description: Per-tenant eBPF aggregate retention in days; null uses the deployment default.

path_retention_days.description: Per-tenant raw path/traceroute retention in days where the backend supports pruning; null uses the deployment default.

audit_retention_days.description: Per-tenant audit retention target in days; pruning still requires durable WORM/SIEM watermarks.

ai_answer_retention_days.description: Per-tenant persisted AI-answer retention in days; null uses the deployment default.

object_retention_days.description: Per-tenant object-artifact retention target in days; enforcement may be delegated to the object store lifecycle.

derived_identity_retention_days.description: Per-tenant topology/endpoint derived identity-cache retention in days; null uses the deployment default.

detail.description: Sanitized RLS health detail. Full catalog/role errors stay in control-plane logs to avoid exposing tenant schema identifiers.

error.description: Sanitized routing error for this tenant only.

token.description: One-time pjt_ enrollment token minted for the caller tenant.

hostname.description: Optional operator label or collector host/source name.

startup_command.description: Optional command to start the matching collector binary with the returned env/YAML hints.
